description: Remove line breaks from text. In 'spaces' mode every line is joined into one with single spaces. In 'paragraphs' mode blank lines are treated as paragraph breaks, so text is joined within each paragraph while the blank line between paragraphs is preserved. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/remove-line-breaks/

mode.description: 'spaces' joins everything into one block (default), 'paragraphs' keeps paragraph breaks

name: hopi_remove_line_breaks

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)

title: Remove line breaks
